info.name: E-Health Care API
info.description:
E-Health Care — Complete Postman Collection v2.1

Generated from Spring Boot source code analysis.

Architecture:
- Backend: Spring Boot on port 8080
- Authentication: JWT Bearer Token (3 separate tokens per role)
- Tokens: sent via Authorization: Bearer <token> header
- Cookies: also set by server (jwt-admin-token, jwt-doctor-token, jwt-patient-token)

Setup:
1. Import EHC_Environment.json into Postman Environments
2. Set base_url = http://localhost:8080
3. Run Login requests — tokens are auto-saved via test scripts
4. All protected requests reference {{admin_token}}, {{doctor_token}}, {{patient_token}}

Folders:
- Admin Auth        : /admin/api/auth
- Admin Management  : /api/admin
- Admin Patient CRUD: /admin/api/patients
- Doctor            : /api/doctor
- Patient           : /api/patient
- Patient Appointment: /api/patient/appointment
- Public            : /api

item.name: Admin Management

request.description:
DELETE /api/admin/doctor/delete/{id}  [PROTECTED]

Deletes a doctor by ID. Cannot be undone.

PUT /api/admin/doctor/update/info  [PROTECTED]

Update doctor information. The `id` field in request body identifies the target doctor. Password and role are preserved from existing record (cannot be changed via this endpoint).

**Fields (Doctor model):**
- id (required): Doctor ID
- email, firstName, lastName, field (specialization), phone, address

PUT /api/admin/doctor/update/password/{id}  [PROTECTED]

Change a doctor's password. Password will be hashed with BCrypt before saving.

item.name: Patient Management

request.description:
DELETE /api/admin/patient/delete/{id}  [PROTECTED]

Deletes a patient by ID.

PUT /api/admin/patient/update/info  [PROTECTED]

Update patient information. The `id` field in request body identifies the target patient. Password is preserved.

PUT /api/admin/patient/update/password/{id}  [PROTECTED]

Change a patient's password. Will be BCrypt-hashed before saving.

item.description: Admin endpoints to manage patients via /api/admin.

request.description:
POST /api/admin/login  [PUBLIC  no auth required]

Simpler admin login endpoint (AdminApiController). Returns token directly.

**Response 200:**
```json
{ "token": "<jwt>" }
```
**Response 401:**
```json
{ "error": "Invalid credentials" }
```

POST /api/admin/logout  [PROTECTED]

Clears SecurityContext server-side.

GET /api/admin/dashboard  [PROTECTED]

Returns all doctors and patients as lists.

GET /api/admin/statistics  [PROTECTED]

Returns counts of doctors, patients, and appointments broken down by status (PENDING, CONFIRMED, CANCELLED).

GET /api/admin/generate-hash  [PUBLIC  no auth required]

Utility endpoint to generate BCrypt password hash. Useful for seeding database.

item.description:
Admin management APIs for Doctors and Patients.
Base path: /api/admin
Auth: Bearer {{admin_token}} in Authorization header (ROLE_ADMIN JWT required)

Public (no auth): POST /api/admin/login, GET /api/admin/generate-hash

item.name: Doctor

request.description:
POST /api/doctor/login  [PUBLIC]

Authenticate doctor with email & password.

Server also sets HttpOnly cookie `jwt-doctor-token` automatically.

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "message": "Login successful",
  "token": "<jwt>"
}
```
**Response 401:**
```json
{ "error": "Invalid credentials" }
```

POST /api/doctor/logout  [PROTECTED]

Clears security context and expires the `jwt-doctor-token` cookie.

GET /api/doctor/profile  [PROTECTED]

Returns profile of the currently authenticated doctor (identified from JWT token).

**Response 200:** DoctorDTO
- id, email, firstName, lastName, field (specialization), phone, address, avatar

PUT /api/doctor/profile/update  [PROTECTED]

Update authenticated doctor's profile. The doctor's ID is inferred from the JWT token (cannot be spoofed).

**Request body:** DoctorDTO fields
- email, firstName, lastName, field, phone, address, avatar
- password (optional, included in DTO)

GET /api/doctor/appointment/list  [PROTECTED]

Returns all appointments assigned to the authenticated doctor.

**Response:** List of Appointment objects
- id, patientId, doctorId, scheduleTime, status (PENDING | CONFIRMED | CANCELLED)

POST /api/doctor/appointment/update/{id}/{status}  [PROTECTED]

Update the status of a specific appointment.

**Path variables:**
- `id`: Appointment ID
- `status`: One of `PENDING`, `CONFIRMED`, `CANCELLED`

**Note:** No request body needed.

GET /api/doctor/dashboard  [PROTECTED]

Returns list of all patients (summary) for doctor's dashboard view.

**Response:** List of PatientSummaryDTO
- id, email, fullName, phone, address, dateOfBirth, firstName, lastName, avatar

POST /api/doctor/patient/{id}  [PROTECTED]

Update clinical information (medical record) for a patient.

**Request body:** PatientClinicalInforDTO
- bloodType: e.g. "A+", "O-"
- allergies: comma-separated string
- chronicDiseases: comma-separated string
- familyMedicalHistory: free text

`patientId` and `lastUpdatedById` are set automatically from path var and JWT token.

item.description:
Doctor authentication, profile, appointments, and patient record management.
Base path: /api/doctor
Auth: Bearer {{doctor_token}} in Authorization header (ROLE_DOCTOR JWT required)

Public: POST /api/doctor/login

item.name: Patient

request.description:
POST /api/patient/register  [PUBLIC]

Register a new patient account.

**Request body:** PatientDTO
- email (required), password (required)
- firstName, lastName, phone, address, dateOfBirth (optional)

POST /api/patient/login  [PUBLIC]

Authenticate patient with email & password.

Server also sets HttpOnly cookie `jwt-patient-token` automatically.

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "message": "Login successful",
  "token": "<jwt>"
}
```

POST /api/patient/logout  [PROTECTED]

Clears security context and expires the `jwt-patient-token` cookie.

GET /api/patient/profile  [PROTECTED]

Returns the full Patient entity for the currently authenticated patient (identified via JWT email).

body.raw:
{
  "email": "patient01@example.com",
  "firstName": "Tran",
  "lastName": "Thi B Updated",
  "phone": "0912999888",
  "address": "Ho Chi Minh City",
  "dateOfBirth": "1990-05-15",
  "medicalHistory": "Updated history",
  "avatar": "default-avatar.png"
}

request.description:
PUT /api/patient/update/{id}  [PROTECTED]

Update patient profile information by ID.

**Request body:** PatientDTO fields
- email, firstName, lastName, phone, address, dateOfBirth, medicalHistory, avatar

GET /api/patient/clinical-info/{id}  [PROTECTED]

Retrieve clinical (medical) information for a specific patient.

**Response:** PatientClinicalInforDTO
- id, patientId, bloodType, allergies, chronicDiseases, familyMedicalHistory, lastUpdatedById, lastUpDatedTime

item.description:
Patient authentication, profile management, and clinical info viewing.
Base path: /api/patient
Auth: Bearer {{patient_token}} in Authorization header (ROLE_PATIENT JWT required)

Public: POST /api/patient/login, POST /api/patient/register

item.name: Patient Appointment

request.description:
GET /api/patient/appointment/doctors  [PROTECTED]

Returns all doctors available for booking. Patient uses this to select a doctor when creating an appointment.

POST /api/patient/appointment/book  [PROTECTED]

Book a new appointment with a doctor.

**Request body:** AppointmentRequestDTO
- doctorId (required): ID of the doctor to book
- scheduleTime (required): ISO 8601 datetime, e.g. `"2026-06-15T10:00:00"`

**Note:** `patientId` is automatically set from the JWT token  do NOT send it in the body.

**Error cases:**
- Duplicate booking at same time slot  400

response.name: 400 Bad Request - Duplicate/Conflict

request.description:
GET /api/patient/appointment/list  [PROTECTED]

Returns all appointments for the authenticated patient. Patient ID is inferred from JWT.

**Response:** List of Appointment objects
- id, patientId, doctorId, scheduleTime, status

item.description:
Patient-facing appointment booking and management.
Base path: /api/patient/appointment
Auth: Bearer {{patient_token}} in Authorization header

All endpoints require patient authentication. PatientId is automatically extracted from JWT (PatientPrinciple).

item.name: Public

request.description:
GET /api/patients  [PUBLIC]

Returns a summary list of all patients.

**Response:** List of PatientSummaryDTO
- id, email, fullName, phone, address, dateOfBirth, firstName, lastName, avatar

GET /api/doctors  [PUBLIC]

Returns a summary list of all doctors.

**Response:** List of DoctorSummaryDTO
- id, email, fullName (firstName + lastName)

item.description:
Public endpoints with no authentication required.

These endpoints return general summary data accessible without a JWT token.
